method: Read every report against the written taxonomy. Existing draft annotations and classifier predictions were not consulted during this pass. The same assistant helped author the synthetic corpus, so this is not an independent reviewer or human ground truth. Uncertainty is retained.
scope: Separate annotation artifact. Does not populate the human-review database, freeze independent labels, alter either classifier, or produce final test scores.
review_service_cost: Codex conversation usage; monetary cost not measured.
